army_rules.name: Code Chivalric
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is Imperial Knights, at the end of the Read the Deed step of your first Command phase, you must determine your army's Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts: one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part. To determine your army's Deed, you can either select one Deed or randomly select one by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. The selected Deed describes what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed. To determine your army's Quality, you can either select one Quality or randomly select one by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability. The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP or 3CP if your selected Quality was randomly selected.

options.name: We Vow to Lay Low the Tyrants
options.rules_text: At the start of the battle, select one Character model in your opponent's army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that Character is destroyed.

options.name: We Swear to Reclaim the Realm
options.rules_text: This Deed is completed at the end of your opponent's turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.

options.name: We Pledge to Reap a Great Tally
options.rules_text: This Deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number.

options.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
options.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.

options.name: Paragons of Honour
options.rules_text: Add 2 inches to this model's Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

options.name: Defend the Realm
options.rules_text: Improve this model's Objective Control characteristic by 1 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

army_rules.name: Bondsman
army_rules.rules_text: Some Imperial Knights models have a Bondsman ability, tagged with the word Bondsman. In your Command phase, one or more models from your army with a Bondsman ability can use that ability. For each one that does, select one friendly Armiger model within 12 inches of that model. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Armiger model is affected by that Bondsman ability.

army_rules.name: Super-heavy Walker
army_rules.rules_text: Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding Titanic models) and sections of terrain features that are 4 inches or less in height. It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4 inches in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

army_rules.name: Freeblades
army_rules.rules_text: If every model in your army has the Imperium keyword, you can include either one Titanic Imperial Knights model or up to three Armiger models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your Warlord, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

rule.name: Dauntless Defenders
rule.rules_text:
At the start of the first battle round, select two objectives to be your foundations. Place a circular foundation marker in each one. When you draw a line from the closest part of one foundation marker to the closest part of the other, if any part of a model's base (or any part of a model's hull, for a model without a base) crosses that line, that model's unit is said to be on your defensive line.

While an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army is on your defensive line, that unit has the following ability:

Against the Horde: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, and weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Acquisitor-at-arms
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is in your defensive line and there are no enemy units on your defensive line, add the bearer's Objective Control characteristic to that of each model affected by the bearer's Bondsman ability.

enhancements.name: Purgation's Hand
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is on your defensive line, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Augury Halo
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, while the bearer is on your defensive line, weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Vengeful Tread
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, you can target the bearer with the Crushing Impact Stratagem for 0CP.

stratagems.name: Drive Them Out!
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit on your defensive line, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Lancebreaker
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from its Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Steadfast Superiority
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that is on your defensive line and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Marshal the Defence
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units from your army that have not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your units.

stratagems.name: Titanic Bombardment
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

stratagems.name: Fortress of Intimidation
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

rule.name: Bold Gallantry
rule.rules_text: Each time an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army Advances, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Iron Chalice
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That selected model regains up to D3 lost wounds, or up to 3 lost wounds if your army is Honoured.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Evanescent Ion
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that selected model has the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Judicant's Helm
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by that selected model have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Lancer's Sigil
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that selected model.

stratagems.name: Run Them Through!
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: Thunderstomp
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured feet melee weapons equipped by your models is 6, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic feet melee weapons equipped by your models is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: Full Tilt
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those models' units.

stratagems.name: Vow of Retribution
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Tactical Foil
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 8" of that unit.
stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Rotate Ion Shields
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

rule.name: Heroes of Legend
rule.rules_text:
At the start of your turn, if your current Oath is fulfilled, determine an additional Oath as described here, with the exception that you cannot select a Deed or Quality you have already selected (if you are randomly selecting the Deed and/or Quality and roll any result that you have already selected, select a Deed or Quality you have not already selected instead). If you cannot determine an additional Oath because you have already selected each Deed and each Quality, do not determine an additional Oath.

The Qualities from Oaths you have fulfilled continue to apply to all models in your army with the Code Chivalric ability. When the Deed for an additional Oath is completed, you instead gain 1CP, regardless of how you selected the Deed or Quality.

additional_rules.name: Valour's Reward
additional_rules.rules_text: The Enhancements shown below can become expended. You cannot use such Enhancements while they are expended. Each Enhancement will state when it becomes expended. While they are expended, they no longer fulfil your Oath; each expended Enhancement is no longer expended.

enhancements.name: Herald of Triumph
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer ends a Charge move, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Wyrm Slayer Divination
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack that targets a unit that can FLY, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Pennant of Silvered Fury
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

enhancements.name: Crushing Condemnation
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Courageous Stand
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Moment of Glory
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3", provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Hero's Tread
stratagems.timing: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Warrior
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Driven by the Past
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rule.name: Knightly Teachings
rule.rules_text: Each time a model from your army uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model from your army has used that Bondsman ability that turn, you can select up to three friendly ARMIGER models (instead of one) within 12" of that model, or within 15" of that model while your army is Honoured (you still cannot select a model that is already being affected by a Bondsman ability). Until the start of your next Command phase, those models are affected by that Bondsman ability.

additional_rules.name: Keywords
additional_rules.rules_text: ARMIGER models from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

enhancements.name: Mentor's Pride
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, each time each of those ARMIGER models makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Fables of Nightmare
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, melee weapons equipped by those ARMIGER models have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Tales of Heroism
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, each time one of those ARMIGER models makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and/or the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Martial Tuition
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more ARMIGER models are under the effects of the bearer's Bondsman ability, once per turn, you can target one of those ARMIGER models with the Counter-offensive Stratagem for 0CP.

stratagems.name: Virtue of Courage
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Exemplar's Wisdom
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, just after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Mantle of the Mentor
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER model from your army or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Thin Their Ranks
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Let Duty Be Your Shield
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Squires of the Hunt
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER model from your army, or one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Rain of Devastation
rule.rules_text: Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS units' attacks that target a unit in a terrain area have +1 to Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Blessed Plate
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS model only. This model has +1T.

enhancements.name: Archeotech Autoloaders
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

stratagems.name: Ground-Shaking Strides
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: Foebreaker Firestorm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's [BLAST] ranged attacks do not have [BLAST] and have +1A.

stratagems.name: Fire Shocked
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one of those attacks. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

rule.name: Cogbound Alliance
rule.rules_text: Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have Assisted Targeting (Aura): while a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit's ranged attacks have +1 BS and [HEAVY]. Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have Sacristan Pledges: in your Command phase, select one friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model within 3" that has not been selected by this ability this phase; if you do, that model heals D3 wounds. Mechanicus Allies: you can include TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS/TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD units in your army; combined points cannot exceed 500 points.

enhancements.name: Magos Questoris
enhancements.rules_text: TECH-PRIEST model only. When using this model's Sacristan Pledge ability, the selected IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model heals 2 additional wounds.

enhancements.name: Knight of the Opus Machina (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit's melee attacks have +1 WS and AP.

stratagems.name: Omnissiah's Grace
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Vengeance of the Machine Cult
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. While a unit is marked, friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units' attacks that target that unit can re-roll Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Giants
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to make an Advance/Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

detachments.name: Throne-bonded Outriders

rule.name: Driven from Their Lairs
rule.rules_text: While a friendly ARMIGER unit is affected by a Bondsman ability, that unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

restrictions: This detachment has the ARMIGERS tag and cannot be taken with another ARMIGERS detachment.

enhancements.name: Gyro-Optimised Actuators
enhancements.rules_text: ARMIGER unit only. This unit has [MOBILE].

enhancements.name: Ancestral Overbleed
enhancements.rules_text: ARMIGER unit only. When you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

stratagems.name: Neural Lash
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly battle-shocked ARMIGER unit within 12" of your unit. That ARMIGER unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Helm Conditioning
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit uses a Bondsman ability.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: When selecting an ARMIGER model for that Bondsman ability, you can select one within 18" of your unit (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).

stratagems.name: Honoured to Serve
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ARMIGER unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ARMIGER unit.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

rule.name: Knights of Legend
rule.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. In addition, at the start of your Command phase, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army regains 1 lost wound.

enhancements.name: Bringer of Justice
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Improve the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Eye
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Mysterious Guardian
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: Place this unit into Strategic Reserves. This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase. This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Sanctuary
enhancements.rules_text: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Noble Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an ARMIGER unit, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Strength from Exile
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Full Tilt
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 3" instead if your unit is an ARMIGER or BERSERKER unit.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Barrage
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, but each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

stratagems.name: Survivor of Strife
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
